lines.t: 1 Thus says the Lord of heaven and earth, I have seen and I have heard.
And no more shall I allow all this iniquity
No more shall I allow all these abominations
Thus says the Lord, your Redeemer
Behold, with many tears I speak to you
You have wandered far from me, you have gone astray
Why, beloved, why have you forsaken me?
Yeah, you are to be my treasure
Oh, how I weep for you
Turn aside and return to me
For I call to you still
In a world which seeks only to consume you
There is no more time to tarry
For the father's indignation to be poured out
And all the children of disobedience shall come to know it
Yes, all these insolent and rebellious peoples
For there is but one salvation
Only one name under heaven by which you must be saved
Only one who can fulfill your hearts' innermost desire
Beloved, come out from among them and be joined unto me
Be sheltered from all these troubles which are coming and are already here
Be spared from all these things
Which I am about to pour out upon this generation
Today is the day of salvation
For I swear by myself, says the Lord, it has begun.
